Core Capabilities

Everything connected. Every phase accounted for.

Construction management centered on the owner's objectives, with flexible services tailored to project complexity and delivery needs.

01 / PLAN

Preconstruction & Planning

Early project assessment, feasibility coordination, scope alignment, budget review, scheduling strategy, and procurement planning.

02 / COORDINATE

Bid & Procurement Support

Bid planning, trade coordination, proposal review, scope reconciliation, and informed contractor selection.

03 / EXECUTE

Construction Management

Active project oversight, field coordination, milestone monitoring, communication, issue resolution, and quality-focused delivery.

04 / REPRESENT

Owner Representation

A consistent point of accountability advocating for the owner's priorities across design, construction, and project stakeholders.

05 / CONTROL

Cost, Schedule & Risk

Budget and change-order awareness, schedule tracking, project reporting, and proactive identification of delivery risks.

06 / COMPLETE

Turnover & Closeout

Coordinating final inspections, punch lists, documentation, project turnover, and a clean transition to operations.

Sustainable Construction & Specialty Delivery

High-performance thinking.
Practical execution.

Whether the goal is LEED certification, better building performance, or a lower lifecycle cost, we can help assemble and coordinate the right qualified professionals and specialty trades.

01

Green building delivery

Coordinate project teams around energy efficiency, responsible material selection, and building-performance priorities.

02

LEED certification coordination

Engage LEED-accredited consultants and qualified partners to support project documentation and certification objectives.

03

Energy & building systems

Coordinate specialized teams for efficient HVAC, controls, electrification, and renewable-energy integration where appropriate.

04

Retrofits & adaptive reuse

Plan and manage improvements that extend asset life, enhance operating efficiency, and limit disruption.

Specialty design, engineering, environmental consulting, and certification services are performed by appropriately qualified independent professionals when required.LEED certification is granted by the relevant certification body and is not guaranteed.
